title: Breach Notification Policy
text: Vendors must notify the company within 72 hours of discovering a security incident.
approved_clause: Vendor will notify Company without undue delay and no later than 72 hours after discovering a security incident.

title: Data Deletion Policy
text: Vendors must delete or return customer data within 30 days after contract termination.
approved_clause: Within 30 days after termination, Vendor will return or securely delete all Company data.

title: Liability Policy
text: The liability cap must be at least 12 months of fees for critical vendors.
approved_clause: Vendor liability will not be less than the fees paid or payable during the preceding 12 months.

title: Audit Rights Policy
text: The company must have the right to audit vendor security controls annually.
approved_clause: Company may audit Vendor's security controls once per year and following a security incident.

title: Renewal Policy
text: Automatic renewal must allow cancellation with no more than 30 days notice.
approved_clause: Either party may prevent renewal by providing 30 days written notice.

title: Payment Policy
text: Standard payment terms must not exceed Net 45 unless approved.
approved_clause: Undisputed invoices are payable Net 45 from receipt.

title: AI Training Policy
text: Customer data, prompts, and outputs must not be used to train shared or provider models without explicit written approval.
approved_clause: Provider will not use Customer Data, prompts, or outputs to train or improve any shared model.

title: Customer Data License Policy
text: Any license to customer data must be limited to providing the contracted services during the agreement term.
approved_clause: Customer grants Provider a limited license to process Customer Data solely to provide the Services during the Term.

title: Data Sharing Policy
text: Customer data may be shared only with approved subprocessors that are necessary to deliver the service.
approved_clause: Provider may disclose Customer Data only to approved subprocessors bound by equivalent obligations.

title: Security Controls Policy
text: Critical vendors must maintain defined administrative, technical, and physical safeguards aligned to a recognized framework.
approved_clause: Provider will maintain the controls in the Security Schedule and an independently assessed security program.

title: Business Continuity Policy
text: Critical providers must maintain and annually test business-continuity and disaster-recovery plans.
approved_clause: Provider will maintain and annually test business-continuity and disaster-recovery plans.

title: Vendor Insurance Policy
text: Critical vendors must maintain appropriate cyber, technology errors and omissions, and commercial liability coverage.
approved_clause: Provider will maintain the insurance coverage specified in the applicable Order Form and provide certificates on request.

title: Subprocessor Policy
text: Providers must maintain a subprocessor list, give advance notice of changes, and provide reasonable objection rights.
approved_clause: Provider will give 30 days notice before adding a subprocessor and will address reasonable objections.

title: Indemnification Policy
text: Indemnities should be mutual, limited to defined third-party claims, and supported by reasonable defense procedures.
approved_clause: Each party will defend and indemnify the other against defined third-party claims caused by its breach or misconduct.

title: Termination Policy
text: Material breach cure periods should not exceed 30 days and convenience rights should not be materially one-sided.
approved_clause: Either party may terminate for uncured material breach after 30 days notice.

title: Service Level Policy
text: Critical hosted services should provide at least 99.9 percent monthly availability and meaningful remedies for chronic failure.
approved_clause: Provider commits to 99.9% monthly availability, with credits and termination rights for chronic failure.

title: Intellectual Property Policy
text: The company must retain ownership of its data and specifically commissioned deliverables.
approved_clause: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data and paid-for deliverables identified in an Order Form.

title: Publicity Policy
text: A provider may not use the company's name, logo, or relationship publicly without prior written approval.
approved_clause: Neither party may issue publicity or use the other party's marks without prior written approval.

title: Dispute Cost Policy
text: Dispute procedures must not require the company to advance the counterparty's legal fees or all neutral costs.
approved_clause: Each party bears its own legal fees and shares neutral arbitration costs, subject to the final award.

title: Assignment Policy
text: Assignment rights should be mutual and permit internal reorganizations and transfers to successors.
approved_clause: Either party may assign to an affiliate or successor with notice; other assignments require consent.

title: Vendor Warranty Policy
text: Providers must warrant professional performance, legal compliance, security obligations, and non-infringement.
approved_clause: Provider warrants that the Services will materially conform to documentation and be performed professionally and lawfully.

title: Confidentiality Policy
text: Confidential information must be used only for the agreement and protected with reasonable care.
approved_clause: The receiving party will use Confidential Information only to perform the Agreement and protect it with reasonable care.

title: Data Retention Policy
text: Customer data retention must be limited to documented operational or legal requirements and defined periods.
approved_clause: Provider will retain Customer Data only for documented purposes and the periods listed in the retention schedule.

title: Cross-Border Transfer Policy
text: International personal-data transfers require approved locations and legally valid transfer safeguards.
approved_clause: Provider will transfer personal data only to approved locations using legally valid safeguards.
